title: Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - ECDC
snippet: 5. Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of 26 May 2026, the outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus has affected the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with increasing numbers of confirmed and suspected cases and deaths. According to the Ministry of Health of DRC on 25 May, a total of 105 confirmed cases (including 10 deaths) and 906 suspected cases (including 223 deaths) have been reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. On 25 May, two suspected cases of Ebola disease were reported in Italy in two people travelling from Uganda to Lombardy. ## Areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda affected by the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak. WHO declares Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern: ECDC continues monitoring. ECDC monitoring Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
